decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The rear ground floor part of the extension with a mono pitched roof does not harm neighbours' living conditions or the appearance of the building and the surrounding area.  This is in compliance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations), and the Residential Extension Guidelines of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

(Reason.  In order to safeguard the visual amenity of the area and building.)

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

(Reason.  To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission)

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the eastern and western wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
(Reason.  To protect the amenities of the neighbouring residential property against increased overlooking with resultant loss of privacy)
description: Retention of mono pitched roof to existing extension to house.
